conventions.figure_frame: LDraw LDU in the minifig's own frame: torso origin at the neck, -Y up, the face looks along -Z, the figure's left is +X. Ground at y = +72 (feet).

neck.description: Head yaw about the neck stud; + turns the face to the figure's left

shoulder_l.description: Left arm about its shoulder pin; + swings the arm forward and up (free spin)

shoulder_r.description: Right arm about its shoulder pin; + swings the arm forward and up (free spin)

wrist_l.description: Left hand about the arm socket axis; + rolls the held item's tip outward (+X)

wrist_r.description: Right hand about the arm socket axis; + rolls the held item's tip outward (-X)

hip_l.description: Left leg about the hip pin; + swings the leg forward (+pi/2 = seated)

hip_r.description: Right leg about the hip pin; + swings the leg forward (+pi/2 = seated)

move_forward.description: Offset of the hip-axis centre along the home facing direction

move_left.description: Offset of the hip-axis centre toward the figure's home left

move_up.description: Height offset of the hip-axis centre

turn.description: Yaw about the vertical through the hip-axis centre; + turns left (counter-clockwise seen from above)

pitch.description: Rotation about the hip axis (figure's left-right line); + leans forward

roll.description: Rotation about the figure's front-back line through the hip-axis centre; + leans toward the figure's left

conventions.whole_figure_transform: world = T(pivot) * T(move_left*left + move_up*up + move_forward*forward) * R(up, turn) * R(left, pitch) * R(back, roll) * T(-pivot); home-frame axes forward=(0,0,-1), left=(1,0,0), up=(0,-1,0), back=(0,0,1). In Blender (figure facing -Y): MOVE location = (move_left, -move_forward, move_up) * 0.0004 m, rotation_mode 'YXZ', rotation_euler = (pitch, roll, turn).
conventions.rules: Every clip starts at the neutral pose (all channels 0) and ends at it (periodic channels may end on whole turns, an identical pose); the figure returns to its home spot.

clips.title: Walk patrol
clips.description: Walks four steps out, turns round, walks back, turns to face front again. Legs alternate, arms counter-swing, the hips dip as the straight legs split.

clips.title: Look around
clips.description: Head scans left and right, then the whole body turns left to look along the street with the head sweeping, and turns back.

clips.title: Halt signal
clips.description: Right arm straight forward to halt traffic, then beckons; the left hand lifts the radio to the chin.

clips.title: Moon hop
clips.description: Four slow low-gravity bounds (two forward, two back to the start): arms swing back, then up in front through the jump, legs split in the air; exact parabolic flight.

clips.title: Zero-g tumble
clips.description: Floats up, turns one slow forward somersault with limbs drifting, and drifts back down to land.

clips.title: Wave
clips.description: Waves with the right arm raised just past vertical (wrist waggles), leaning away and glancing to the right; then a smaller wave with the left hand in front of the chest.

clips.title: Sword slash
clips.description: Three diagonal slashes: blade raised in front, then the wrist rolls it outward and down while the body turns and lunges into the cut; the shield stays on guard.

clips.title: Shield block
clips.description: Raises the shield in front of the chest in a braced stance with the sword held low, takes three blows (jolts back), peeks round the shield between blows, counter-thrusts and relaxes.

clips.title: Courtly bow
clips.description: Sword hand to the chest (blade across the body), shield arm back, bows from the hips (legs stay upright, feet planted), rises and finishes with the blade raised before the face.

clips.title: Hammering
clips.description: Leans in holding a nail with the left hand and strikes five times with the hammer, the last two faster; the body nods into each blow.

clips.title: Carry load
clips.description: Both arms held forward as if carrying a load; short careful steps out, turn round, back, turn to the front and lower the arms.

clips.title: Shrug and head shake
clips.description: Shrugs (both arms forward a little, hands roll outward), shakes the head 'no', then a facepalm with the free left hand.

clips.title: Stirring
clips.description: Stirs a pot with the ladle (bowl down): shoulder and wrist oscillate a quarter cycle apart so the bowl circles; the pan hangs at the side; glances aside, then taps the ladle twice.

clips.title: Pan flip
clips.description: Holds the frying pan level in front and flips three times (dip, flick up with a wrist snap, follow the pancake); the third flip comes with a hop; then points at the pan with the ladle.

clips.title: Celebrate
clips.description: Arms up in front (utensils rolled outward), three happy hops with kicking legs and waving hands, a full spin, fist pumps, arms down.

clips.title: Hornpipe jig
clips.description: Ten alternating forward kicks with a little hop on the standing leg, arms swinging, body twisting with each kick.

clips.title: Lookout
clips.description: Left hand raised to shade the eyes, leans to peer and scans the horizon left and right with body and head; spots something and points the cutlass at it.

clips.title: Cutlass lunge
clips.description: En garde stance, two fencing lunges (thrust, front leg forward, back leg extended), recover, then a flourish with the blade swung out to the side.

clips.title: Ladder climb
clips.description: Climbs four rungs of an imaginary ladder in front (16 LDU each) with alternating hands gripping at chest-to-face height and alternating feet, looks around at the top, climbs back down.

clips.title: Run
clips.description: Runs out (fast leg and arm swing, forward lean, a short flight lift at each stride), turns round with a skid, runs back and turns to the front. Feet slide: travel is shorter than the stride.

clips.title: Hose sweep
clips.description: Braced stance, both hands forward on the hose, sweeps the spray left and right with body and head and leans back against the pressure.

clips.title: Sprint
clips.description: Set position, sprints out with big leg and arm swings and a strong forward lean, turns round, jogs back and turns to the front.

clips.title: Spin jump
clips.description: Two arm pre-swings, a big jump (75 LDU) with a full turn in the air, arms straight up and legs tucked, landing with a forward lean, fist pumps overhead and a victory hop.

clips.title: Warm-up
clips.description: Arms forward for balance: three right-leg swings, three left-leg swings (the body counter-leans), then forward arm circles.

clips.title: Spell spin
clips.description: Raises both arms forward (staff up), pirouettes a full turn with the head lagging, points the staff forward and twirls it with the wrist.

clips.title: Levitate
clips.description: Arms forward with the palms rolled out, rises 40 LDU, hovers with a slow bob and yaw while the legs dangle, and settles back down.

clips.title: Cast spell
clips.description: Raises the staff, casts it down and forward with a lean and a step (recoil back), twice; then circles the staff with the wrist.

clips.title: Swim crawl
clips.description: Rises into imaginary water and lies prone (pitch pi/2), front-crawl arms windmill half a stroke apart with a flutter kick and side breaths, then rights itself, drifts home and sinks.

clips.title: Sit down and stand up
clips.description: Sits down on the floor leaning back a little (legs flat, hip axis lowered to the seated height, flippers point up), hands at the sides, waves and looks around while seated, stands back up.

clips.title: Fall and get up
clips.description: Stumbles backward, falls onto its air tanks (the hip axis swings round the heels), kicks and flails, sits up, stands up and walks back to the start.
